name: Kakami Mayura
source:
The absolute ruler within Shikagami mansion. A sadist who commands.

At the same time, a servant to everyone in the mansion, inflicting the torment they secretly desire.

Using maids and young slave girls, she subdues the [url=/c104657]protagonist[/url] through shame and pleasure. A beautiful and noble aura coexists with innocence, an innocent yet devilish charm.

[Translated from the [url=https://zero.product.co.jp/products/hodse/character.html]official website[/url]]
